 D·engage Successfully Completes SOC 2 Type II Examination 
D·engage is proud to announce the successful completion of its SOC 2 Type II examination as of February 10, 2026, reinforcing our commitment to security, governance, and operational excellence across our customer experience data platform.
As organizations manage increasing volumes of customer data across multiple channels, independent validation of security controls has become a key requirement in vendor evaluation processes. The SOC 2 Type II examination confirms that D·engage’s control environment has been independently assessed over a defined audit period and found to operate effectively.
Strengthening Enterprise Security Standards
SOC 2 Type II is an independent attestation that evaluates both the design and operational effectiveness of controls relevant to security and related trust criteria. Unlike a point-in-time review, a Type II examination assesses how controls function consistently over time.
For D·engage customers, this milestone provides assurance that:
Security controls are formally established and consistently applied
Governance and oversight processes are documented and maintained
Risk management practices are integrated into operations
Data protection responsibilities are clearly defined
This achievement supports enterprise security, procurement, and compliance teams in conducting structured vendor assessments with greater confidence.
Built for Flexible Deployment Models
D·engage supports organizations with flexible deployment options, including both cloud-based and on-premise environments. Regardless of deployment model, security and control discipline remain foundational to how we design, operate, and support our platform.
The SOC 2 Type II examination reflects our commitment to maintaining a structured and accountable control environment that aligns with enterprise expectations across different infrastructure configurations.
“The Dengage team achieved this milestone through speed, teamwork, and sharp focus, completing the full SOC 2 Type II process well ahead of industry norms. At Dengage, trust isn’t just a feature; it’s our foundation. This examination proves our deep commitment to data security, so our customers can move fast with confidence.”
Mustafa Bilge
Chief Administration Officer, D·engage 
Transparency Through the D·engage Trust Center
As part of our commitment to openness and accountability, D·engage maintains a dedicated Trust Center where stakeholders can access information about our security and compliance practices.
Through the Trust Center, customers can review:
Security and compliance resources
Information regarding our control framework
Details about subprocessors supporting service delivery
A Continued Investment in Trust
Completing the SOC 2 Type II examination represents an important milestone in our broader security and compliance program. It reflects our commitment to maintaining strong operational controls, improving transparency, and supporting enterprise-grade requirements.
As D·engage continues to grow and evolve, we remain focused on strengthening our security posture and responsibly managing the data entrusted to our platform.
Explore the Trust Center here:
https://trust.dengage.com/
This centralized resource is designed to streamline due diligence processes and provide clarity into how D·engage safeguards customer information.
